claims.summary: FEATURE_ABS_MAX (L32) clamp may conflict with vibrancy lift (L35-39) if the entropy-gated offset is not subtracted before the final clamp, muting outputs.
claims.disposition: Structural challenge. The vibrancy path (feedback.rs apply_spectral_feedback_inner L224-318) does NOT subtract an offset before clamp; it RAISES the clamp ceiling for tail dims 17|26|27|31 up to TAIL_VIBRANCY_MAX so the added lift is not flattened (comment L292-296). Below the gate tail_vibrancy=0 -> ceiling collapses to FEATURE_ABS_MAX (byte-identical). L35-39 is doc, not logic. Tests L2961/L2940 confirm no muting.

claims.summary: Test #2: mock spectral_entropy=0.90, assert the entropy gate (L48) triggers the vibrancy lift and output exceeds FEATURE_ABS_MAX (L32) by the gated offset.
claims.disposition: Verified_existing. Mechanism is a raised ceiling, not a post-clamp offset.

claims.summary: Suggested Next: examine project_embedding_dynamic_epoch_with_source (L774-818) for how source-specific context influences dynamic epoch selection.
claims.disposition: Read-only research answer (Tier 1). The '_with_source' param is projection_epoch_source: a provenance LABEL (env|file|kernel_derived|explicit, L686-718) threaded into ProjectionMetadata. It does NOT influence epoch SELECTION: the seed derives from projection_epoch_id ^ hash(text) ^ chunk_index (L784-795); the epoch id itself is chosen by load_or_create_projection_epoch_id. No source-code context affects selection.
